definitions.explanation: A suffix indicating a way of viewing or perspective on something.

examples.japanese: {価値|かち}{観|かん}が{違|ちが}う。
{人生|じんせい}{観|かん}が{変|か}わった。
{世界|せかい}{観|かん}を{広|ひろ}げる。

notes:
〜{観|かん} is a suffix meaning "view of," "outlook on," or "sense of." It attaches to nouns to create abstract concepts about how one perceives or understands something.

COMPOUNDS:
- {価値観|かちかん}: values, sense of values
- {人生観|じんせいかん}: view of life, philosophy of life
- {世界観|せかいかん}: worldview
- {歴史観|れきしかん}: view of history
- {自然観|しぜんかん}: view of nature
- {倫理観|りんりかん}: ethical sense, moral outlook
- {死生観|しせいかん}: view of life and death

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{観|かん}が{変|か}わる: one's view of ~ changes
- 〜{観|かん}を{持|も}つ: to hold a view of ~
- 〜{観|かん}が{違|ちが}う: to have different views on ~

USAGE:
Do not confuse with 〜{感|かん} (feeling/sense), which expresses a subjective impression rather than a philosophical outlook. Example: {安心感|あんしんかん} (sense of relief) uses {感|かん}, not {観|かん}.
